paragraphs.text: Numot (NOO-maht) , the Devastator , is a male primeval dragon on Dominaria in an alternate timeline.

Numot is a male primeval dragon from Dominaria that was seen during the Temporal crisis of Dominaria . He is a large golden-scaled dragon, with horns and a goatee. He wears silvery jewelry around his neck.
The four other alternate timeline primeval dragons are Intet , Oros , Teneb and Vorosh .
